description: This file implements an output interception mechanism for the Ginkgo testing framework, including interfaces, structs, and functions to start, pause, resume, and shutdown output interception, as well as handling pipes and cloning stdout/stderr.

classes.name: NoopOutputInterceptor
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the OutputInterceptor interface that performs no actual interception.

classes.name: genericOutputInterceptor
classes.description: A struct implementing output interception with pipe management, cloning, and control methods.

classes.name: osGlobalReassigningOutputInterceptorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of interceptor methods that reassign os.Stdout and os.Stderr globally.

methods.name: startPipeFactory
methods.description: Creates pipes and sends them through a channel, handling shutdown signals.

methods.name: CreateStdoutStderrClones
methods.description: Creates clones of stdout and stderr.

methods.name: ConnectPipeToStdoutStderr
methods.description: Redirects stdout and stderr to a pipe writer.

methods.name: RestoreStdoutStderrFromClones
methods.description: Restores stdout and stderr from their clones.

methods.name: ShutdownClones
methods.description: Shuts down stdout and stderr clones.
